title: the hotel
content: there is this hotel i went to only once but i remember it vividly. one minute i was in a section covered in teal curtains and teal carpeting, with a trussed ceiling way overhead. it led to curtains at the end of the hall, beyond which was a bedroom completely furnished in red. when you entered it you could feel the coolness of the satin sheets. behind the curtain of the wall adjacent to where i entered was another opening to a marble hallway, and so this was actually a corner between two sections disguised as a bedroom. walking toward the end of the hallway and turning left, it finally opened up to a luxurious hotel lobby with a bar and lounge area. anybody dream about a similar place with a linear path through completely different zones?
